NNEW CONCEPT ENGLISHBOOK 01 / 新概念英语

BOOK ONE · LESSON 062

What's the matter with them? What must they do?

他们怎么啦？他们该怎么办？

A bilingual lesson about people's illnesses (headache, earache, toothache, stomach ache, temperature, flu, measles, mumps) and what they must do, with workbook practice on joining sentences with so/because and short answers, plus grammar on must/mustn't. 关于各种疾病（头痛、耳痛、牙痛、胃痛、发烧、流感、麻疹、腮腺炎）以及病人必须做什么的双语课程，配合教材 so/because 连句和简短回答练习，以及 must/mustn't 的语法练习。

Notes on the text 课文注释

take an aspirin

相当于 have an aspirin，服(吃)一片阿司匹林。

have a temperature

发烧。

02

MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Practice 练习

A So and because

Join the sentences with the word so - and then with the word because. 分别用 so 和 because 来连接以下各组句子。

Join each pair of sentences with so, then with because.

Each item gives both the so-sentence and the because-sentence, in that order. Item 1 is a printed example and is not editable.

B About you

Answer these questions with full sentences. 用完整的句子回答以下问题。

Answer each question in a full sentence about yourself.

The supplied key gives model answers: 1 No, I don't often have a cold or a headache. 2 Yes, I sometimes have a stomach ache. 3 No, I don't often have a toothache. 4-5 My dentist's/doctor's name is Mr./Mrs. ...... and his/her telephone number is ...... 6 I must stay in bed and call a doctor.
